integrity: All theorem bounds have a self-contained analytic proof. The attached finite exact-arithmetic checks test identities only and are not independent validation. No unverified equality at an interior angle is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-variable ordinary Taylor second-Hankel determinant only. Gives sharp leading boundary asymptotics, not the interior-angle sharp function, nor Banach-space directional sharpness. Full text of two older plausible comparator papers was inaccessible, so bibliographic equivalence risk remains.
title: Sharp grazing-angle Hankel asymptotics for spirallike-convex maps
